text: Artificial intelligence is transforming our world, but it also raises important ethical questions. One major concern is bias, as AI systems can learn from data that contains unfair prejudices, leading to discriminatory outcomes. To ensure fairness, we must carefully examine and correct these datasets. Another key issue is privacy, since AI often collects large amounts of personal information, which requires strong safeguards to protect individuals. Transparency is also vital—people should understand why an AI makes certain decisions, especially in areas like hiring or healthcare. Ultimately, responsible AI development means creating systems that are safe, accountable, and aligned with human values, benefiting everyone without causing harm.
